description: This file defines a tracing and event logging system for the Go programming language, including data structures, functions for rendering HTML debug pages, and management of event logs and families.

classes.name: eventFamily
classes.description: Manages a collection of event logs grouped by family name.

classes.name: eventLog
classes.description: Represents an individual event log with timestamped entries, including error marking and stack trace.

classes.name: logEntry
classes.description: Represents a single timestamped log entry within an event log.

methods.name: RenderEvents
methods.description: Renders an HTML page displaying event logs and statistics, typically served at /debug/events.

methods.name: parseEventsArgs
methods.description: Parses URL query parameters to select a specific event family and bucket.

methods.name: NewEventLog
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new event log with specified family and title.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Marks an event log as complete and removes it from its family.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an event log to an event family.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an event log from its family.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Counts recent error events within a family based on age threshold.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies recent error event logs from a family for display.

methods.name: Printf
methods.description: Adds a formatted message as a new event entry.

methods.name: Errorf
methods.description: Adds a formatted error message as a new event entry.

methods.name: WhenString
methods.description: Returns a string of the event's timestamp, including date if on a different day.

methods.name: ElapsedTime
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the event log started.

methods.name: Stack
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the call stack at log creation.
